name: G2 Kunsthalle
notes: G2 Kunsthalle in Leipzig, on the third floor of the former data processing centre of the city (VEB Datenverarbeitungszentrum, built 1986–89 in the Kolonnadenviertel) at Dittrichring 13: a long six-storey block of pale panels with punched windows in rows between piers, floor-edge bands, shop fronts at street level, a set-back top floor with a glass-enclosed lounge, facing the ring road and the reopened Pleißemühlgraben. History from the Kunsthalle's and the city's pages; footprint and height from the OpenStreetMap ground; the facade's panels, windows and the lounge's place are guessed. No photographs were available.
